actions.name: Use
actions.area: all allies within a 30-ft.-burst, centered on caster

duration.value: 1 hour/level or until discharged; see text

description.summary: This spell acts like False Life , but affects all allies in 30 feet radius and grants 3d10 + caster level temporary hit points
description.value: This spell acts like False Life , but affects all allies in 30 feet radius and grants 3d10 + caster level temporary hit points. This effect does not stack with False Life or False Life, Greater .
